_description: This file demonstrates how to create a custom theme preset with a corporate brand style using blue tones. Copy this file and modify it to create your own preset.
name: Corporate Blue
description: Professional corporate theme with blue accents and clean typography
author: Your Name

vars._accent_comment: Primary accent color used for links, borders, and decorative elements. This blue (#0066CC) conveys trust and professionalism.
vars._fontSize_comment: Base font size for paragraph text. Standard web font size for optimal readability.
vars._lineHeight_comment: Line height for text (unitless ratio). 1.75 provides comfortable reading spacing.
vars._textColor_comment: Primary text color. Dark blue-gray (#2C3E50) is softer than pure black and reduces eye strain.
vars._codeBg_comment: Background color for code blocks. Light blue tint (#F0F7FF) matches the corporate theme.
vars._inlineCodeColor_comment: Text color for inline code. Darker blue (#0052A3) ensures good contrast against light background.
vars._blockquoteBg_comment: Background color for blockquotes. Very light blue (#E8F4FD) distinguishes quoted content.
vars._maxWidth_comment: Maximum width of the content area. 680px is optimal for desktop reading.
vars._headings_note: Headings H1-H3 support background colors and padding. H4-H6 only support font size, weight, and color.
vars._h1_note: H1 has a light blue background (#E8F4FD) with rounded corners, making it stand out as a major section header.
vars._h2_note: H2 uses a solid left border (from accent color) for visual hierarchy without background.
vars._h3_note: H3 continues the color hierarchy with a medium blue, maintaining visual consistency.
vars._h4_note: H4 uses the primary accent color for visual connection to links and interactive elements.
vars._h5_note: H5 uses a lighter blue while maintaining sufficient contrast for readability.
vars._h6_note: H6 is the lightest heading color, suitable for minor subdivisions.

decorations._note: These are optional decorative elements for future expansion
decorations._h1Divider_comment: Whether to show a divider line below H1 headings (not yet implemented).
decorations._h2Icon_comment: Optional icon/emoji to display before H2 headings (not yet implemented). Example: '📘'

preview._note: These colors are used in the theme dashboard UI to preview the preset.
preview._primary_comment: Primary preview color - typically the same as accent color.
preview._background_comment: Background preview color - usually white or very light tint.
preview._accent_comment: Accent preview color - used for highlights and secondary UI elements.

how_to_use: 1. Copy this file to create your own preset
3. Update the 'id' field with a unique identifier (lowercase, hyphens only)
4. Modify the 'name' and 'description' to describe your theme
5. Adjust color values in the 'vars' section to match your brand
6. Update the 'preview' colors to match your theme
7. Place the file in the .wechat/presets/ directory
8. Select it from the theme dashboard in VSCode
tips: Maintain sufficient contrast for accessibility (WCAG AA: 4.5:1 for normal text)
Test your theme in WeChat's actual editor preview
Keep heading colors darker than body text for hierarchy
Use accent color sparingly for emphasis
Consider color blindness when choosing color combinations
